<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 235.1395. Assuming this is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is ≈ 235.1395 – 1.0073 = 234.1322 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₁₄H₁₈O₃ (monoisotopic mass = 234.1256 Da, within a few mDa of the observed value). No other hetero‑atoms are required to fit the mass, so the formula is simply C14H18O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
